content.p: The term "classified information" has the meaning given in section 1.1 of Executive Order 13526 (50 U.S.C. 3161 note) or any successor order.

note.heading: References in Text
note.p: Executive Order 13526, referred to in text, is set out as a note under section 3161 of Title 50, War and National Defense.

note.heading: Report
note.p: Not later than 90 days after enactment, the Director shall report on compliance with Executive Order No. 12333.

note.heading: Ex. Ord. No. 10450. Security Requirements for Government Employment
note.p: Ex. Ord. No. 10450, Apr. 27, 1953, 18 F.R. 2489, as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 10491, Oct. 13, 1953, 18 F.R. 6583; Pub. L. 101–509, title V, § 529, Nov. 5, 1990, 104 Stat. 1427, provided:
Section 1. In addition to the departments and agencies specified in Executive Order No. 9835 of March 21, 1947, the provisions apply to all agencies.
Sec. 2. [Revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 14000, § 4, Jan. 2, 2021, 86 F.R. 100.]
Sec. 3. Executive Order No. 9835 of March 21, 1947, as amended, is hereby revoked.

note.heading: Executive Order No. 11230
note.p: Ex. Ord. No. 11230, June 28, 1965, 30 F.R. 8447, as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 11275, Mar. 31, 1966, 31 F.R. 5283; Ex. Ord. No. 11294, Aug. 4, 1966, 31 F.R. 10601, delegating certain functions, was superseded by Ex. Ord. No. 11609, July 22, 1971, 36 F.R. 13747, set out as a note under this section.

note.heading: Executive Order No. 14100
note.p: Ex. Ord. No. 14100, Mar. 1, 2026, 91 F.R. 5000, which related to testing, was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 14999, Dec. 1, 2026, 91 F.R. 99999.
